en.name: Secure Mail MCP
en.summary: A provider-neutral blueprint for building safety-first mail MCP servers.
en.solves: It separates mail-provider adapters from MCP policy and confirmation boundaries.
en.architecture: MCP server, provider interface, IMAP/SMTP adapters, and an explicit confirmation gate.
en.included: Threat model, environment example, test plan, and implementation guidance.
en.excluded: Private production code, credentials, deployment OAuth configuration, and provider account data.
en.security: Read operations are conservative; sending and mutations require explicit confirmation.
en.uses: Building an account-scoped IMAP/SMTP MCP server.

zh.name: 安全邮件 MCP
zh.summary: 用于构建安全优先邮件 MCP 服务器的、与提供商无关的蓝图。
zh.solves: 将邮件提供商适配器与 MCP 策略及确认边界分离。
zh.architecture: MCP 服务器、提供商接口、IMAP/SMTP 适配器和明确的确认门。
zh.included: 威胁模型、环境变量示例、测试计划和实现指南。
zh.excluded: 私有生产代码、凭据、部署 OAuth 配置和提供商账户数据。
zh.security: 读取操作保持保守；发送和变更必须明确确认。
zh.uses: 构建账户范围内的 IMAP/SMTP MCP 服务器。

en.name: Device Bridge
en.summary: A blueprint for permission-aware MCP bridges to local device data.
en.solves: It defines a boundary between an AI-facing MCP server and privileged device APIs.
en.architecture: MCP transport, device-bound relay, permissioned platform adapter, and audit-friendly mutation policy.
en.included: Boundary model, transport guidance, and safety constraints.
en.excluded: Production device relay code, user data, and device credentials.
en.security: Device permissions are explicit; destructive operations need confirmation and safe defaults.
en.uses: Connecting AI to calendar, sensor, or platform data through a local bridge.

zh.name: 设备桥接
zh.summary: 用于连接本地设备数据的、具备权限意识的 MCP 桥接蓝图。
zh.solves: 定义面向 AI 的 MCP 服务器与特权设备 API 之间的边界。
zh.architecture: MCP 传输、设备绑定中继、受权限保护的平台适配器和便于审计的变更策略。
zh.included: 边界模型、传输指南和安全约束。
zh.excluded: 生产设备中继代码、用户数据和设备凭据。
zh.security: 设备权限必须明确；破坏性操作需要确认并采用安全默认值。
zh.uses: 通过本地桥接将 AI 连接到日历、传感器或平台数据。
